svg.text: Slotting – single-cycle time per slot and ABC zones on one rack side (side L, aisle view)
crane 3 m/s, 0.5 m/s²; hoist 1 m/s, 0.5 m/s²; stop = 3 s positioning + 4.87 s fork + lift = 7.87 s; SC = 2 × move(I/O → slot) + 2 stops · zone A ≤ 33.1 s, B ≤ 39.2 s
EXAMPLE – check the AS/RS supplier's documentation
Guide 34 · AS/RS raw materials – WMS / ERP / MES · values = examples (ASRS-RAW, V-compressor factory)
S01 … S28 counted from the I/O point (left). First upright at x = 1.2 m; I/O transfer point at x = 0, fork level 0.75 m. Numbers = single-cycle time in s.
COI ranking (cube-per-order index) for the average stock of guide 03 §20.5 – 154 loads
COI_i = slots needed by item i ÷ retrievals per hour of item i (lowest COI → fastest slots; Heskett)
mean cycle = Σ (r_i × mean SC of the slots of i) ÷ Σ r_i
zone sizes follow the stock of each class; re-slot in quiet hours (crane idle) – every re-slot move costs one crane cycle
ABC by MOVES for slotting (cylinders, crankshafts = A), ABC by VALUE for purchasing (guide 03 §20.1) – two different lists
